title: 第3章 添新坟遥望江湖第4章 入后天峥嵘初露
slug: 我在大虞当杀手那些年
content_zh:
不知过了多久。
也许是一秒，也许是一年，也许是一个世纪。
裴礼始终没有等到致命一刀，身边突然有什么东西倒在地上。
紧接着，一股暖流被拍进了身体。
“小家伙，你叫我一声师父，咱俩就算认识了。”
一道苍老且柔和的声音在耳边响起。
这应该是个慈祥的老爷爷。
裴礼张了张嘴，轻轻吐出两个字，“师…父…”
“诶！”
老者由心的应了一声，唇角不由自主的上扬。
心中好似有某根柔软的心弦被拨动，竟是有种热泪盈眶的冲动。
想他李琛在江湖里漂泊了大半辈子，虽然也混出一点名堂，但一直孤独一人。
如今，他也有亲人了。
裴礼突然感觉有一股暖流源源不断的被灌输入自己的身体。
如果说先前的暖流是一滴水的话，那现在就是一条奔腾的大河。
他能明显感觉到，身体的伤势在迅速好转。
仅仅片刻，他已是能站起来。
“走吧。”
李琛拉住裴礼的手，“咱们离开这。”
“师父，那些土匪？”

“都死了。”
裴礼略微沉默，继而道：“我还有件事……”
“你这个死瞎子，死的那个人为什么不是你！”
“都怪你这个灾星，是你把土匪引来的！”
王强好似疯魔，歇斯底里的咆哮，“如果你离开了村子，我儿子也不会死！”
“找死！”
李琛刚要一巴掌拍死那个家伙。
“师父，算了。”
“此种不知好歹的人，留他做甚？”
李琛眉头一皱，以为裴礼是心慈手软之人。
若是这般，可不合他的意。
“爷爷下葬的时候，他帮忙抬了棺材。”
裴礼说完，走向秀秀一家三口的尸体，将他们的眼睛轻轻合上。
这一刻，所有村民沉默的看着那个小瞎子。
这才知道，瞎子，不瞎。
李琛愣愣出神，看向裴礼的眼神愈发柔和。
半晌，
他吐出一口气，抬头看着漫天的飞雪，喃喃自语，“我这算是捡到宝了吗？”
后山上，一座新坟旁边，又添了两座新坟。
雪花很快就在坟头上堆积了厚厚一层，仿佛要将他们存在的最后痕迹抹去。

两块墓碑插在坟前，证明他们曾经来过。
裴礼跪在坟前，身上落满了雪，脑中思绪烦乱，有个疑问在脑海挥之不去。
content_en:
I don’t know how much time passed.
Maybe it's a second, maybe it's a year, maybe it's a century.
Pei Li never waited for the fatal blow, when something suddenly fell to the ground beside him.
Immediately afterwards, a warm current was shot into the body.
"Little guy, if you call me Master, we will know each other."
An old and soft voice sounded in his ears.
This should be a kind old grandfather.
Pei Li opened his mouth and softly uttered two words, "Master...father..."
"Hey!"
The old man responded heartily, the corners of his lips rising involuntarily.
There seemed to be a soft heartstring being plucked in my heart, and there was an urge to burst into tears.
I think Li Chen has been wandering in the world for most of his life. Although he has made a name for himself, he has always been alone.
Now, he also has relatives.
Pei Li suddenly felt a steady flow of warmth being poured into his body.
If the previous warm current was a drop of water, it is now a roaring river.
He could clearly feel that his physical injuries were improving rapidly.
In just a moment, he was able to stand up.
"Let's go."
Li Chen took Pei Li's hand and said, "Let's get out of here."
"Master, those bandits?"
"All dead."
Pei Li was silent for a moment, then said: "I have something else..."
"You blind man, why weren't you the one who died?"
"It's all my fault, you disaster star. It's you who attracted the bandits!"
Wang Qiang was like a madman, roaring hysterically, "If you leave the village, my son will not die!"
"Seeking death!"
Li Chen was about to slap that guy to death.
"Master, forget it."
"What can we do with such a ungrateful person?"
Li Chen frowned, thinking that Pei Li was a kind-hearted person.
If this is the case, it is not to his liking.
"When grandpa was buried, he helped carry the coffin."
After Pei Li finished speaking, he walked towards the corpses of Xiuxiu's family and gently closed their eyes.
At this moment, all the villagers looked at the little blind man in silence.
Only then did I know that a blind person is not blind.
Li Chen was stunned and looked at Pei Li with softer eyes.
For a long time,
He exhaled, looked up at the flying snow in the sky, and murmured to himself, "Am I a treasure?"
On the back hill, next to a new tomb, two new tombs were added.
Snowflakes soon accumulated a thick layer on the graves, as if to erase the last traces of their existence.
Two tombstones were placed in front of the grave, proving that they had been here.
Pei Li knelt in front of the grave, his body covered with snow, his mind was disturbed, and there was a question lingering in his mind.
